page.layout: One printed page, cut off at the right edge of the scan. Upper right: four or five lines of running text, partly mirrored, probably show-through from the other side. Middle right: a spaced capital line "T I N." below it a small woodcut ornament. Left of the printed area: blank paper and the edge of the neighbouring leaf. Bottom right: a handwritten shelf mark, not transcribed.
page.notes: The scan shows only the right edge of a printed page; most of the text is cut off by the page edge and the lines are too faint to read. The upper lines look mirrored, so they are probably show-through and are not transcribed as text. The woodcut ornament below "T I N." is not text. The handwritten number at the bottom right is a library shelf mark and is excluded. The reading "T I N." is uncertain.
